fixed.summary: Unifies creation choices, labels, and JSON schema in `packages/knowledge/scripts/creation.ts` (including the `tactical-arctic` UI theme), fixes the 4-argument `resolveCreationChoices` call so custom `catalogue` paths are honored, and stops duplicating `styles/`, `fonts/`, `looks/`, `previews/`, and obsolete `locales/` inside `@origingame/create-game` (reading them once from `@origingame/engine`).
Lists built-in theme slugs in invalid `ui "<name>"` look diagnostics instead of printing an empty list.
